sloka: विमलग्रहनक्षत्रा शारदी द्यौरिवेन्दुना ।तं पश्यमानो नृपति स्तुतोओष प्रियमात्मजम् ॥२-३-३७॥
transliteration: vimalagrahanakṣatrā śāradī dyaurivendunā ।taṁ paśyamāno nṛpati stutooṣa priyamātmajam ॥2-3-37॥

translations.english: The king was delighted to see his beloved son as though he saw his own reflection adorning a mirror.
